{{Quote|We're going to destroy the barracks of the 72nd Imperial Army Division, based in Coronet. The explosives are of Mon Cal manufacture&hellip;extremely rare. Since the Mon Cal are open supporters of the Rebellion, it will look very much like a Rebel operation.|[[Hakasha Sireen]], to a pilot|<ref name="LI" />}}
The '''72nd Imperial Army Division''' was a [[Division/Legends|division]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] based several barracks in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]],<ref name="LI" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The division was active there during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="LI" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the Imperial [[Special forces/Legends|special operations]] unit [[Black Epsilon]] planned to destroy the barracks of the 72nd Imperial Army Division in order to blame the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and justify an Imperial invasion of Corellia.<ref name="SWG:HS">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=conversation|Hakasha Sireen|Talus}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The 72nd Imperial Army Division was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'', the first expansion pack for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] that was released in [[2004]].<ref name="SWGMB">[[Star Wars Galaxies Memory Book|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Memory Book]]</ref>
